verdict.rationale: vLLM documents an official CLI reference page. It covers starting the OpenAI-compatible API server, an interactive mode that prints TTFT and throughput statistics, and benchmark runs for latency and throughput. Serving flags such as `--trust-remote-code` are also documented. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances (e.g. machine-readable output, scripting-friendly modes), full subcommand detail beyond short snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
Print TTFT and throughput statistics after each response
Run benchmark tests for latency online serving throughput and offline inference throughput.
